items.author: LumenToolsHQ
items.text:
ChatGPT dots are rolling out: an always-on agent with its own cloud computer that connects to your apps and keeps working between chats.

The setting that matters most is Custom rules. For each kind of action, you pick one:
- Take action without asking
- Take action if pre-approved
- Ask before taking action
- Hand off to you

Some steps, like changing a password, always stay with you.

My take: an always-on agent is only as safe as its defaults. Start yours on "ask first" with one low-stakes job, read what it does for a week, then loosen the rules.

What's the first job you'd hand to an agent that never logs off?

zh-CN.title: Dots 的自定义规则：先从“先问我”开始
zh-CN.summary: 作者说 Dots 最关键的设置是自定义规则：每类操作可选“直接执行”“预先批准才执行”“执行前询问”或“交给你”，改密码等步骤始终由你处理。他建议先设为“先问”，只交一件低风险的事，观察一周再放宽。

zh-TW.title: Dots 的自訂規則：先從「先問我」開始
zh-TW.summary: 作者說 Dots 最關鍵的設定是自訂規則：每類操作可選「直接執行」「預先核准才執行」「執行前詢問」或「交給你」，改密碼等步驟始終由你處理。他建議先設為「先問」，只交一件低風險的事，觀察一週再放寬。

en.title: Dots Custom rules: start on "ask first"
en.summary: The author says the key Dots setting is Custom rules: for each kind of action you choose take action without asking, take action if pre-approved, ask before taking action, or hand off to you; steps like changing a password always stay with you. He suggests starting on "ask first" with one low-stakes job, watching it for a week, then loosening.

ja.title: Dots のカスタムルールは「先に確認」から
ja.summary: 作者によれば Dots で最も重要なのはカスタムルール。操作の種類ごとに「確認なしで実行」「事前承認なら実行」「実行前に確認」「あなたに引き継ぐ」を選べ、パスワード変更などは常に本人が行う。まず「先に確認」でリスクの低い仕事を一つ任せ、1 週間様子を見てから緩めることを勧めている。

ko.title: Dots 맞춤 규칙: “먼저 묻기”로 시작
ko.summary: 작성자는 Dots에서 가장 중요한 설정이 맞춤 규칙이라고 한다. 작업 종류마다 묻지 않고 실행, 사전 승인 시 실행, 실행 전 묻기, 사용자에게 넘기기 중 하나를 고르며 비밀번호 변경 같은 단계는 항상 사용자 몫이다. 먼저 “먼저 묻기”로 위험이 낮은 일 하나를 맡기고 일주일 지켜본 뒤 풀라고 권한다.

ms.title: Peraturan tersuai Dots: mula dengan "tanya dahulu"
ms.summary: Penulis berkata tetapan paling penting dalam Dots ialah peraturan tersuai: bagi setiap jenis tindakan anda pilih bertindak tanpa bertanya, bertindak jika dipra-lulus, tanya sebelum bertindak, atau serahkan kepada anda; langkah seperti menukar kata laluan sentiasa kekal dengan anda. Dia cadangkan mula dengan "tanya dahulu" untuk satu tugas berisiko rendah, perhati seminggu, kemudian longgarkan.

vi.title: Quy tắc tùy chỉnh của Dots: bắt đầu bằng "hỏi trước"
vi.summary: Tác giả nói thiết lập quan trọng nhất của Dots là quy tắc tùy chỉnh: với mỗi loại hành động, bạn chọn tự làm không hỏi, làm nếu đã duyệt trước, hỏi trước khi làm, hoặc giao lại cho bạn; các bước như đổi mật khẩu luôn do bạn làm. Anh khuyên bắt đầu ở "hỏi trước" với một việc ít rủi ro, theo dõi một tuần rồi mới nới.

fr.title: Règles personnalisées de Dots : commencer par « demander d'abord »
fr.summary: L'auteur estime que le réglage clé de Dots, ce sont les règles personnalisées : pour chaque type d'action, on choisit agir sans demander, agir si pré-approuvé, demander avant d'agir ou vous passer la main ; des étapes comme changer un mot de passe restent toujours à vous. Il conseille de commencer par « demander d'abord » sur une tâche peu risquée, d'observer une semaine, puis d'assouplir.

es.title: Reglas personalizadas de Dots: empieza con "preguntar antes"
es.summary: El autor dice que el ajuste clave de Dots son las reglas personalizadas: para cada tipo de acción eliges actuar sin preguntar, actuar si está preaprobado, preguntar antes de actuar o pasártelo a ti; pasos como cambiar una contraseña siempre quedan en tus manos. Recomienda empezar con "preguntar antes" en una tarea de bajo riesgo, observar una semana y luego relajar las reglas.

de.title: Dots-Regeln: mit „erst fragen“ beginnen
de.summary: Der Autor hält die benutzerdefinierten Regeln für die wichtigste Dots-Einstellung: Pro Aktionsart wählt man ohne Nachfrage handeln, bei Vorabfreigabe handeln, vorher fragen oder an dich übergeben; Schritte wie ein Passwortwechsel bleiben immer bei dir. Er rät, mit „erst fragen“ und einer risikoarmen Aufgabe zu starten, eine Woche zuzusehen und dann zu lockern.

items.author: opanterasi
items.text:
Measure how many times a week you have to chase your AI assistant. With mine, from 10/30 to 11/05, it was 29 of my 141 messages. This week, 12 of 145.

I use it a lot: it builds reports, organizes my calendar, reads email and prepares study pages.

I was reading a Grok Bot guide from xAI that talks about an attention list: compare where your attention really goes with what you say your priorities are.

And I had been feeling a different kind of tired: I had become the quality control.

So I sorted every message of mine by type. Chasing is "where is it?", "again?", "redo it".

The result bothered me a lot. Of the 18 times I chased it right after a delivery, 15 were the same thing: the page had been created, but it never reached me.

The assistant said "done". The file existed. And I saw nothing.

The fix was not asking harder. It was changing who checks.

Now a check looks at whether the page actually showed up in the conversation, instead of trusting the "done". If it didn't, it gets shown again before any message goes out.

And the same count runs every week, so I can see if it dropped.

In my view, this is the metric that matters most for anyone using agents day to day.

It is not how many tasks it did. It is how many times you had to remind, chase or trigger by hand what should have happened on its own.

Because an assistant that does a lot, but needs your attention to check everything, just moved the work somewhere else.

I still have 12 chases to knock down.

Source: https://t.co/8xmRjByveK

zh-CN.title: 统计“追问助手”次数：从 29/141 降到 12/145

en.title: Counting how often you chase your assistant: 29/141 down to 12/145
en.summary: The author counted messages chasing her AI assistant: 29 of 141 from 10/30 to 11/05, and 12 of 145 this week. Of 18 chases right after a delivery, 15 were the same issue: the page was created but never reached her. The fix was a check that the page actually appears in the conversation, re-showing it before any message goes out, with the count rerun weekly.

ko.title: 비서를 재촉한 횟수 세기: 29/141에서 12/145로

ms.title: Kira berapa kali anda mengejar pembantu: 29/141 turun ke 12/145

Penyelesaiannya ialah semakan bahawa halaman benar-benar muncul dalam perbualan, dipaparkan semula sebelum mesej dihantar, dengan kiraan diulang setiap minggu.

vi.title: Đếm số lần phải giục trợ lý: từ 29/141 xuống 12/145

Trong 18 lần giục ngay sau khi giao, 15 lần là cùng một lỗi: trang đã tạo nhưng không tới tay cô. Cách sửa là một bước kiểm tra xem trang có thật sự hiện trong cuộc trò chuyện, nếu không thì hiện lại trước khi gửi tin, và đếm lại mỗi tuần.

fr.title: Compter combien de fois on relance son assistant : de 29/141 à 12/145

La solution : un contrôle vérifiant que la page apparaît vraiment dans la conversation, sinon elle est réaffichée avant tout message, avec un comptage refait chaque semaine.

en.summary: The author says building your own AI agent is the most expensive way to learn what you need. His team exposed its systems as tools, put people on Claude Code, Codex and Copilot, built a custom agent, then moved to Grok Bot; he says the order mattered more than the tool.

ja.title: 自前のエージェントを作った後、チームは Grok Bot へ移行
ja.summary: 作者は、自前の AI エージェントを作るのは本当に必要なものを知る最も高くつく方法だという。チームはシステムをツールとして公開し、Claude Code、Codex、Copilot を使わせ、独自エージェントを作った後で Grok Bot に移った。道具より順番が大事だったと述べる。

ko.title: 자체 에이전트를 만든 뒤 팀이 Grok Bot으로 옮김
ko.summary: 작성자는 AI 에이전트를 직접 만드는 것이 진짜 필요한 것을 알아내는 가장 비싼 방법이라고 한다. 팀은 시스템을 도구로 열고, 사람들에게 Claude Code, Codex, Copilot을 쓰게 했으며, 자체 에이전트를 만든 뒤 Grok Bot으로 옮겼다. 도구보다 순서가 더 중요했다고 말한다.

ms.title: Selepas membina ejen sendiri, pasukan beralih ke Grok Bot
ms.summary: Penulis berkata membina ejen AI sendiri ialah cara paling mahal untuk mengetahui apa yang sebenarnya diperlukan. Pasukannya mendedahkan sistem sebagai alat, meletakkan orang pada Claude Code, Codex dan Copilot, membina ejen tersuai, kemudian beralih ke Grok Bot; katanya urutan lebih penting daripada alat.

vi.title: Sau khi tự xây agent, đội chuyển sang Grok Bot
vi.summary: Tác giả nói tự xây agent AI là cách tốn kém nhất để biết mình thực sự cần gì. Đội anh mở hệ thống thành công cụ, cho mọi người dùng Claude Code, Codex và Copilot, tự xây một agent, rồi chuyển sang Grok Bot; anh cho rằng thứ tự quan trọng hơn công cụ.

fr.title: Après avoir construit leur propre agent, une équipe passe à Grok Bot
fr.summary: L'auteur estime que construire son propre agent IA est la façon la plus chère de découvrir ce dont on a besoin. Son équipe a exposé ses systèmes comme outils, mis les gens sur Claude Code, Codex et Copilot, construit un agent maison, puis est passée à Grok Bot ; selon lui, l'ordre a compté plus que l'outil.

es.title: Tras construir su propio agente, un equipo se pasó a Grok Bot
es.summary: El autor dice que construir tu propio agente de IA es la forma más cara de descubrir lo que necesitas. Su equipo expuso sus sistemas como herramientas, puso a la gente en Claude Code, Codex y Copilot, creó un agente propio y luego se pasó a Grok Bot; afirma que el orden importó más que la herramienta.

de.title: Nach dem eigenen Agenten wechselte ein Team zu Grok Bot
de.summary: Der Autor sagt, einen eigenen KI-Agenten zu bauen sei der teuerste Weg herauszufinden, was man braucht. Sein Team stellte seine Systeme als Tools bereit, setzte Leute auf Claude Code, Codex und Copilot, baute einen eigenen Agenten und wechselte dann zu Grok Bot; die Reihenfolge sei wichtiger gewesen als das Werkzeug.

zh-TW.title: Mac 版 Grok Bot 的郵件權限是「搜尋和起草」，不是寄出
zh-TW.summary: 作者指出很多人以為 Mac 版 Grok Bot 現在能替你寄郵件，但介面上郵件一項寫的是「搜尋和起草郵件」，並不是寄出；訊息一項則是「讀取和傳送訊息」。

en.title: Grok Bot on Mac: Mail is "search and draft", not send

ja.title: Mac 版 Grok Bot のメールは「検索と下書き」で送信ではない

ko.title: Mac용 Grok Bot의 메일 권한은 “검색 및 초안”, 발송 아님
ko.summary: 작성자는 사람들이 Mac용 Grok Bot이 이제 이메일을 보낼 수 있다고 생각하지만, 화면의 메일 항목은 “이메일 검색 및 초안 작성”이지 발송이 아니라고 지적한다. 메시지 항목은 “메시지 읽기 및 보내기”다.

ms.title: Grok Bot pada Mac: Mail ialah "cari dan draf", bukan hantar
ms.summary: Penulis menegaskan ramai menyangka Grok Bot pada Mac kini boleh menghantar e-mel, tetapi baris Mail pada skrin tertulis "Search and draft emails", bukan hantar; baris Messages pula "read and send messages".

vi.title: Grok Bot trên Mac: Mail là "tìm và soạn nháp", không phải gửi
vi.summary: Tác giả chỉ ra nhiều người nghĩ Grok Bot trên Mac giờ gửi được email, nhưng dòng Mail trên màn hình ghi "Search and draft emails", không phải gửi; còn dòng Messages ghi "read and send messages".

fr.title: Grok Bot sur Mac : Mail, c'est « rechercher et rédiger », pas envoyer
fr.summary: L'auteur souligne que beaucoup croient que Grok Bot sur Mac peut maintenant envoyer des e-mails, mais la ligne Mail à l'écran indique « Search and draft emails », pas l'envoi ; la ligne Messages indique « read and send messages ».

es.title: Grok Bot en Mac: Mail es "buscar y redactar", no enviar
es.summary: El autor señala que mucha gente cree que Grok Bot en Mac ya puede enviar correos, pero la fila de Mail en pantalla dice "Search and draft emails", no enviar; la de Mensajes dice "read and send messages".

de.title: Grok Bot auf dem Mac: Mail heißt „suchen und entwerfen“, nicht senden
de.summary: Der Autor weist darauf hin, dass viele glauben, Grok Bot auf dem Mac könne jetzt E-Mails senden, doch in der Mail-Zeile steht „Search and draft emails“, nicht Senden; bei Nachrichten steht „read and send messages“.

items.author: silentguyy66
items.text:
Holy f*ck, give Grok Bot these 6 github repos and a problem worth solving.

A job tracker. an invoice generator. an appointment calendar. a client portal.

Pick one. ask Grok Bot for a build brief. use it to direct your cloud coding agent.

6 repos, sorted by what you could build:

The job tracker:
→ dnd-kit - drag applications between applied, interview and offer
https://t.co/WcQON6FcDD

the invoice generator:
→ react-pdf - turn client details and line items into a downloadable PDF
https://t.co/9Dc4kVGBst

the appointment calendar:
→ fullcalendar - display meetings in day, week and month views
https://t.co/u27OLmbECD

the sales dashboard:
→ recharts - turn revenue and customer data into charts
https://t.co/h8n1VVarJl

the workflow editor:
→ react flow - connect steps on a canvas before wiring up the actions
https://t.co/jrBZLqLTev

the client upload portal:
→ uppy - add a file upload interface for briefs, images and documents
https://t.co/kNAfnxIfrp

Start with the task you already do in a spreadsheet every week.

Send this to Grok Bot:

“Write a build brief for a job application tracker using dnd-kit. three columns: applied, interview, offer. cards with company, role, link and notes. drag-and-drop between columns. save everything locally.

Define the data structure, implementation steps and acceptance checks. keep the first version to one screen.”

Give the brief and repo link to your cloud coding agent.

Build it. move a card. refresh the page. check that your data survives.

Fix what breaks before adding more features.

Save the repos. pick one app idea.

Then read the guide below to build your first app with grok bot and cloud agents ↓

zh-CN.title: 用 6 个 GitHub 仓库让 Grok Bot 写构建简报
zh-CN.summary: 作者列出 6 个仓库（dnd-kit、react-pdf、fullcalendar、recharts、react flow、uppy），分别对应求职追踪、发票、预约日历、销售看板、流程编辑器、客户上传门户。做法：让 Grok Bot 写构建简报，再把简报和仓库链接交给云端编程智能体；先做一屏，测试刷新后数据仍在，修好再加功能。

zh-TW.title: 用 6 個 GitHub 倉庫讓 Grok Bot 寫建置簡報
zh-TW.summary: 作者列出 6 個倉庫（dnd-kit、react-pdf、fullcalendar、recharts、react flow、uppy），分別對應求職追蹤、發票、預約行事曆、銷售儀表板、流程編輯器、客戶上傳入口。做法：讓 Grok Bot 寫建置簡報，再把簡報和倉庫連結交給雲端程式代理；先做一屏，測試重新整理後資料仍在，修好再加功能。

en.title: Six GitHub repos plus a Grok Bot build brief
en.summary: The author lists 6 repos (dnd-kit, react-pdf, fullcalendar, recharts, react flow, uppy) for a job tracker, invoice generator, appointment calendar, sales dashboard, workflow editor and client upload portal. Method: ask Grok Bot for a build brief, give it and the repo link to a cloud coding agent, keep version one to one screen, check data survives a refresh, and fix breaks before adding features.

ja.title: 6 つの GitHub リポジトリと Grok Bot のビルド指示書
ja.summary: 作者は求人管理、請求書、予約カレンダー、売上ダッシュボード、ワークフローエディタ、顧客アップロードポータル向けに 6 つのリポジトリ（dnd-kit、react-pdf、fullcalendar、recharts、react flow、uppy）を挙げる。Grok Bot にビルド指示書を書かせ、それとリポジトリのリンクをクラウドのコーディングエージェントに渡す。最初は 1 画面にし、リロード後もデータが残るか確認し、直してから機能を足す。

ko.title: GitHub 저장소 6개와 Grok Bot 빌드 브리프
ko.summary: 작성자는 구직 트래커, 인보이스 생성기, 예약 캘린더, 매출 대시보드, 워크플로 편집기, 고객 업로드 포털용 저장소 6개(dnd-kit, react-pdf, fullcalendar, recharts, react flow, uppy)를 소개한다. Grok Bot에 빌드 브리프를 받아 저장소 링크와 함께 클라우드 코딩 에이전트에 넘기고, 첫 버전은 한 화면으로, 새로고침 후 데이터가 남는지 확인하고 고친 뒤 기능을 더하라고 한다.

ms.title: Enam repo GitHub dan taklimat binaan Grok Bot
ms.summary: Penulis menyenaraikan 6 repo (dnd-kit, react-pdf, fullcalendar, recharts, react flow, uppy) untuk penjejak kerja, penjana invois, kalendar janji temu, papan pemuka jualan, editor aliran kerja dan portal muat naik pelanggan. Kaedah: minta Grok Bot tulis taklimat binaan, beri bersama pautan repo kepada ejen pengekodan awan, hadkan versi pertama kepada satu skrin, semak data kekal selepas muat semula, dan baiki sebelum menambah ciri.

vi.title: Sáu repo GitHub và bản brief dựng app từ Grok Bot
vi.summary: Tác giả liệt kê 6 repo (dnd-kit, react-pdf, fullcalendar, recharts, react flow, uppy) cho trình theo dõi xin việc, tạo hóa đơn, lịch hẹn, bảng doanh số, trình sửa quy trình và cổng tải tệp cho khách. Cách làm: nhờ Grok Bot viết brief, giao brief và link repo cho agent lập trình trên đám mây, bản đầu chỉ một màn hình, kiểm tra dữ liệu còn sau khi tải lại, sửa lỗi rồi mới thêm tính năng.

fr.title: Six dépôts GitHub et un brief de construction Grok Bot
fr.summary: L'auteur cite 6 dépôts (dnd-kit, react-pdf, fullcalendar, recharts, react flow, uppy) pour un suivi de candidatures, un générateur de factures, un agenda de rendez-vous, un tableau de ventes, un éditeur de workflow et un portail de dépôt client. Méthode : demander un brief à Grok Bot, le donner avec le lien du dépôt à un agent de code cloud, limiter la v1 à un écran, vérifier que les données survivent à un rechargement, corriger avant d'ajouter.

es.title: Seis repos de GitHub y un brief de construcción de Grok Bot
es.summary: El autor enumera 6 repos (dnd-kit, react-pdf, fullcalendar, recharts, react flow, uppy) para un tracker de empleos, generador de facturas, calendario de citas, panel de ventas, editor de flujos y portal de subida para clientes. Método: pedir a Grok Bot un brief, dárselo con el enlace del repo a un agente de código en la nube, limitar la primera versión a una pantalla, comprobar que los datos sobreviven a recargar y arreglar antes de añadir funciones.

de.title: Sechs GitHub-Repos und ein Build-Brief von Grok Bot
de.summary: Der Autor nennt 6 Repos (dnd-kit, react-pdf, fullcalendar, recharts, react flow, uppy) für Bewerbungstracker, Rechnungsgenerator, Terminkalender, Vertriebs-Dashboard, Workflow-Editor und Kunden-Upload-Portal. Vorgehen: Grok Bot ein Build-Brief schreiben lassen, es mit dem Repo-Link einem Cloud-Coding-Agenten geben, Version eins auf einen Bildschirm beschränken, prüfen, ob Daten ein Neuladen überstehen, und erst reparieren, dann erweitern.

ja.title: 米国の家庭向け無料 Grok Bot「College Aid Finder」
ja.summary: 作者は、米国のどの州でも大学費用に悩む家庭向けに無料の Grok Bot「College Aid Finder」を作ったという。すべての道を教えてくれる人がいないため多くの家庭が支援を取り逃しており、数千ドルかかるサービスもあると述べている。

ko.title: 미국 가정을 위한 무료 Grok Bot: College Aid Finder

ms.title: Grok Bot percuma untuk keluarga AS: College Aid Finder

vi.title: Grok Bot miễn phí cho gia đình Mỹ: College Aid Finder

fr.title: Un Grok Bot gratuit pour les familles américaines : College Aid Finder
fr.summary: L'auteur dit avoir créé un Grok Bot gratuit, College Aid Finder, pour les familles de tout État américain confrontées au casse-tête du financement des études. es.title: Un Grok Bot gratis para familias de EE. UU.: College Aid Finder
es.summary: El autor dice que creó un Grok Bot gratuito, College Aid Finder, para familias de cualquier estado de EE. UU. que enfrentan el laberinto de pagar la universidad. de.title: Ein kostenloser Grok Bot für US-Familien: College Aid Finder
de.summary: Der Autor sagt, er habe einen kostenlosen Grok Bot namens College Aid Finder für Familien in jedem US-Bundesstaat gebaut, die mit der Studienfinanzierung kämpfen. Viele Familien ließen Geld liegen, weil ihnen niemand alle Wege zeige, und manche Dienste kosteten Tausende Dollar.
